description: This source file defines the WorkActivityStore class, which manages the state of ongoing activities such as jobs and tools within the application. It handles activity lifecycle events, session management, icon state derivation, and integrates with other parts of the system via imported modules like Observation, OpenClawKit, and OpenClawProtocol.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle and state of work activities such as jobs and tools, providing interface methods to handle activity events and derive UI states.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore.Activity
classes.description: A data structure representing an activity with session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Processes job start and end events, updating internal activity states accordingly.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Handles tool phase changes, updating activity states and scheduling delayed removal to manage UI flicker.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines the icon's visual state based on current activities and optional overrides.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used by the store, with validation.
